story.title: Story 5: Manual Smart Compact And PI Reload

result.reviewScopeSummary: Reviewed Story 5’s manual smart compact path end to end: async-thread readiness, draft rebuild, PI target build/write/archive/load, command-surface wiring, and the mapped Story 5 tests from the test plan. I also ran the targeted Story 5 suites plus the story and epic gates, and manually repro’d uncovered projection-format behavior against the real code.

newFindings.title: PI projection rewrites raw system-role messages as user messages
newFindings.evidence: `src/thread-view/targets/pi/pi-thread-view-builder.ts:34-52` only preserves `targetMetadata.piRole` when it is `user`, `assistant`, or `toolResult`, and otherwise maps `actorType === "system"` to `user`. `src/thread-view/targets/pi/pi-thread-view-writer.ts:223-235` then serializes every non-`user`/`toolResult` entry as an assistant message, so there is no path that preserves a distinct system/custom role in the generated session file. A direct repro with `buildPiThreadViewFile` + `writePiThreadViewFile` on a raw message carrying `targetMetadata.piRole: "system"` produced `file.entries[0].role === "user"` and a JSONL message with `message.role: "user"`. This breaks the story/tech-design requirement that the PI-target file use PI’s native session-file format and preserve mapped target metadata where possible.

newFindings.title: The Story 5 integration/E2E coverage promised in the test plan is still missing
newFindings.evidence: `docs/spec-build/epics/03-deterministic-band-and-projection-mechanics/test-plan.md:283-323` explicitly calls for `tests/thread-view/pi-thread-view-writer.integration.test.ts`, `tests/commands/smart-compact.integration.test.ts`, and `tests/commands/smart-compact.e2e.test.ts` to cover the real file-backed write/archive/load path and full smart-compact command loop. The current tree under `tests/commands` and `tests/thread-view` contains only unit suites (`tests/commands/smart-compact.test.ts`, `tests/thread-view/pi-thread-view-builder.test.ts`, `tests/thread-view/pi-thread-view-writer.test.ts`, etc.), and `rg -n "lh-smart-compact|runSmartCompact|smart compact" tests --glob '*.integration.test.ts' --glob '*.e2e.test.ts'` returned no Story 5 deep tests. `npm run verify-all` passed only because unrelated integration/E2E suites exist elsewhere, so the deep gate does not currently provide the story-specific proof the test plan requires.

Story 5 integration coverage planned in `tests/thread-view/pi-thread-view-writer.integration.test.ts` and `tests/commands/smart-compact.integration.test.ts`

productionPathFindings: Raw full-fidelity messages with system-role metadata are projected to `user` in the generated PI session file, so the production output path does not preserve all mapped target roles correctly.
openQuestions: `tech-design.md` still lists the default omitted smart-compact mode as an open question, but `src/context-steward/pi/pi-extension.ts:449-455` currently defaults a missing `--mode` to `strict`. Is that product decision now ratified?
additionalObservations: The mapped Story 5 unit suites, the production command-surface tests in `tests/context-steward/pi-extension-commands.test.ts:632-754`, the story gate, and the epic gate all pass; the blockers above are uncovered semantic/coverage gaps rather than failing automation.
I did not find a disallowed fake adapter, shim, or placeholder execution branch in the runtime smart-compact path beyond the deterministic placeholder content that the story explicitly requires.
